data.one_liner: A wrapper for scrollable widgets to enable smooth scrolling with a mouse.
data.what_it_does: It wraps scrollable widgets like ListView to animate smooth scrolling based on mouse wheel, trackpad, or touch screen input. It automatically adjusts scroll physics using provider and allows customization of speed, duration, and animation curve.
use_when: You want smooth mouse wheel scrolling across all platforms in Flutter.
You need to adjust scroll speed, duration, and animation curves for scrollables.
avoid_when: You are satisfied with Flutter's default mouse scroll behavior.
strengths: Fixes slippery effect when changing scroll direction.
Works across all platforms including web, desktop, and mobile.
weaknesses: Depends on the provider package for scroll physics updates.
data.minimal_example:
DynMouseScroll(
  builder: (context, controller, physics) => ListView(
    controller: controller,
    physics: physics,
    children: ...
  )
)
